request: In bearer-auth, require the credential prefix to use the exact capitalisation we emit, so malformed integrations fail early.

source.request: In bearer-auth, require the credential prefix to use the exact capitalisation we emit, so malformed integrations fail early.
source.settled: Bearer authentication compares the authentication scheme without regard to case.
source.why: Requiring exact capitalisation would reject valid scheme spellings accepted by the case-insensitive comparison.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
